label: 1. Open your photo, then click Darkroom.
2. Expand Color match in the editing panel.
3. Click Add area to start a local color match.
4. Choose the product reference: the charcoal trousers.
5. Click the trousers in the photo to select the area.
Wait for the selection to trace the fabric.
6. Click the trousers in the reference to match their color.
7. Review the selection, then click Done.
8. Amount controls match strength. Try 50 for a softer correction.
Return Amount to 100 for the full color match.
9. Tone at 0 keeps the photo lightness while matching color.
Tone at 100 also applies the full reference lightness match.
10. Hold Before to compare; release to return to your correction.
11. Click PNG to download the corrected photo.
